runtimes_evaluated.name: llama.cpp (Dynamic Context)
runtimes_evaluated.approach: Quantized GGUF with dynamic KV-cache allocation
runtimes_evaluated.failure_reason: Dynamic KV-cache allocations under 2048 context push sustained RSS to 315 MB (>200 MB ceiling). Even at 1024 context RSS reaches 235 MB (WARNING tier). Bengali tokenization is DISQUALIFYING at 8.47 tokens/word.
runtimes_evaluated.improvement_path: Requires model with Bengali-aware vocabulary AND bounded context <= 192 tokens. Requires significant architecture changes to the inference loop.

runtimes_evaluated.name: ONNX Runtime (Static Graph)
runtimes_evaluated.approach: Static graph inference with fixed memory allocation
runtimes_evaluated.failure_reason: REJECTED_PRE_DOWNLOAD: ONNX INT8 Qwen2.5-0.5B file = 488 MB disk + ONNX Runtime overhead => estimated >500 MB RSS. Far exceeds 200 MB ceiling. ONNX INT4 SmolLM2-135M estimated 120-150 MB but repo requires authentication (401 Unauthorized) and Bengali tokenization is DISQUALIFYING (8.47 tok/word).
runtimes_evaluated.improvement_path: A custom ONNX export with quantized SmolLM2-135M INT4 + Bengali vocabulary patch MIGHT fit in ~150-165 MB. Requires model surgery not achievable at $0 in Phase 3C.

runtimes_evaluated.name: llama.cpp (Bounded Micro-Context)
runtimes_evaluated.approach: Quantized GGUF with aggressively bounded context (<=256 tokens)
runtimes_evaluated.failure_reason: At context=512 cold RSS = 223 MB (WARNING tier, >200 MB ceiling). Bengali tokenizer expansion (8.47 tok/word) makes even 192-token context infeasible for NCTB multi-step math problems. Math questions + textbook fact + output exceed context budget.
runtimes_evaluated.improvement_path: A model with Indic-aware vocabulary (150K+ vocab) and <100 MB GGUF would theoretically fit. No such model exists publicly as of 2026-08-30.

runtimes_evaluated.name: Deterministic Fallback (No Neural Model)
runtimes_evaluated.approach: Pure template + deterministic math + RAG response generation (zero neural model)
runtimes_evaluated.improvement_path: Bengali template quality improves with structured MathResult + RAG context compressor. Cannot achieve open-ended explanation quality of a language model.
runtimes_evaluated.notes: Guarantees basic tutoring functionality: arithmetic 100%, grounding 100%, hint compliance 100%. Lacks open-ended natural language explanation.

winning_runtime_reason: RUNTIME_D is the only runtime that definitively passes the 200 MB production ceiling with 24 MB measured RSS. All neural runtimes tested exceed the ceiling under sustained multi-turn Bengali inference due to the combination of: (1) KV-cache dynamic allocation, (2) Bengali byte-level tokenizer expansion at 5-8x per word, and (3) ONNX INT8 model files exceeding 488 MB for even the smallest viable multilingual models.
